status: Approved visual references; independent production layers, native gameplay admission pending
pivotConvention: Normalized UV of full padded image/cell. Anchors share that UV. unit gives full canvas world width/height; never stretch a character non-uniformly.
collisionNote: alpha/solid bounds are measurements, not full rectangle colliders; holes and disconnected anatomy remain empty.

korr.animationNote: Four keyed raster poses, not a skeletal rig or smooth full walk cycle. Shared scale 3px/world unit and supporting-foot baseline; release hoof extends in front of support plane.

bell.note: 14u dome circle; top loop is decorative. Pivot at dome mass, not bounding-box centre.

ramp.note: Map the measured contact anchors to physics ramp endpoints; preserve cap/hinge aspect. Pin sits below the top face.

lift.note: Empty open railing; deck plane anchor supports Lumi, finial is presentation.

ratchet.note: Static mounting base baked with wheel; rotate only wheel via masked/cropped layer if animated.

plinth.note: Rear-stage load-bearing dais. Supporting feet sit on measured top plane; not a foreground full-width blocker.

hopperStudy.note: Historical narrow-mouth hopper study, NOT admitted for28u bells; use open bellCradle instead.

releaseLever.note: Source-aligned arm/base split at bearing underside. Rotate releaseLever only; leverMount remains fixed.

leverMount.note: Source-aligned arm/base split at bearing underside. Rotate releaseLever only; leverMount remains fixed.

bellCradle.note: Open-front release rack, not a narrow tube. Outlet is inside true-alpha opening, mapped to actualbell birth(164,147). Bell exits downfield without passing visible metal; source3D perspective remains baked.

background.role: Static quiet architectural plate only. No character, brick, bell, wheel, raft, UI or collision geometry.

nerraBody.note: Body plus eight short legs, no large claws; use exact socket anchors for separate front claws.

crusherClaw.note: Mirror horizontally at its root for left/front socket; angle then applies to the whole anatomical part.

gateClaw.note: Right gate-handling short arm; root is real rear ball, not claw centre.

wheel.note: Actual source wheel face is oblique; use affine rotation in its own plane or bounded rocking, not unexamined full-screen 2D spin.

raft.note: Empty deck, no baked bricks. Full width128u; map measured deck span for real code-placed cells.

gate.note: Opaque physical panel; do not draw balls through its visible area.

counterweight.note: Stone/metal body; top eye remains transparent inside.

coral.note: Equal-sized glossy ceramic tile. Draw contact anchors to real34x18u brick; source aspect normalized consistently across the family.

sage.note: Equal-sized glossy ceramic tile. Draw contact anchors to real34x18u brick; source aspect normalized consistently across the family.

ivory.note: Equal-sized glossy ceramic tile. Draw contact anchors to real34x18u brick; source aspect normalized consistently across the family.

sluiceWall.note: Rear-stage masonry support and three true-alpha arch outlets. No full-width foreground collision barrier.

refugeBalcony.note: Lumi feet align to actual deck. Front railing may be occlusion-masked after Lumi; not a new cage.

gateFrame.note: Empty true-alpha aperture. Map opening corners to actual gatepanel; frame is rear-stage hardware, not an invisible full rectangle.

background.role: Static quiet architectural plate only. No character, brick, bell, wheel, raft, UI or collision geometry.

collisionConvention: Each disk fully inscribed in alpha>=128, relative to normalized pivot at declared unit scale. Conservative union, never fills leg/jaw gaps. Shapes are not a traced rig.
